533:t_000:8.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Understood. Then the $$クォーター$$ and the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ will keep watch over the surrounding area.」

533:t_000:9.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(The Empire's army, annihilated... Is this a coincidence...?)

533:t_000:10.en:
$$ゼロ$$
(And if it is not, has whoever eliminated the Empire noticed what I am after...?)

533:t_001:0.en:
$$モニカ$$
「$$新地球皇国$$ confirmed! It's the $$沈黙の巨蟹$$, $$尸空#pilot$$'s unit!」

533:t_001:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「All members who went to the ruins have been recovered!」

533:t_001:2.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Launch all units at once.」

533:t_002:0.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go! Time to pick up where that live set left off!」

533:t_003:0.en:
$$アルト$$
「$$バサラ$$'s really pushing it!」

533:t_003:1.en:
$$ミシェル$$
「He must not have sung nearly enough.」

533:t_003:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「That's rare. $$ゼロ$$ letting $$バサラ$$ do his own thing.」

533:t_003:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「What breaks through a stifling situation like this is explosive vitality.」

533:t_003:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「The captain has taken another assignment. I will command today.」

533:t_003:8.en:
$$尸刻$$
「I know. Those are ones who cannot coexist with us.」

533:t_003:9.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Striking them down is the duty of us, the $$鬼宿$$, is it not?」

533:t_003:11.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Buy me a little time, please.」

533:t_003:12.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「Could it be... we're being targeted?」

533:t_003:13.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「Looks like we stood out a little too much.」

533:t_003:14.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「Don't mind them, $$バサラ$$! I'll deal with that lot! You sing!」

533:t_003:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「You don't have to tell me!」

533:t_003:16.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Let's go, $$サイデリアル$$! Hear my song!!」

533:t_005:0.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$エルドスピーネ$$! The $$マーティアル$$ have come!」

533:t_005:1.en:
$$スザク$$
「I heard they were fighting the Empire, though...」

533:t_006:1.en:
$$クルツ$$
「And it looks like we're next on their list!」

533:t_006:2.en:
$$マオ$$
「Same old crowd that can't read the room!」

533:t_006:3.en:
$$尸刻$$
「...Thanks to you, I have gained time.」

533:t_006:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「What is she planning, that lady...!?」

533:t_006:5.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Listen to the melody I play.」

533:t_006:6.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Zetsu... In... A... Gou... Goku... Shuu...」

533:t_007:1.en:
$$宗介$$
「The strength is... draining out of my whole body...!」

533:t_007:3.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「The principle is unknown. However, a decline in Ensign $$レド$$'s physiological functions can definitely be observed.」

533:t_007:4.en:
$$チェインバー#pilot$$
「Body temperature dropping, pulse decreasing, pupils dilating... This phenomenon closely resembles a state of death.」

533:t_007:7.en:
$$テイタニア$$
「$$キリコ$$ is refusing to fight...!」

533:t_007:8.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「So if we stay here, we are only waiting for death!」

533:t_007:10.en:
$$ガムリン$$
「$$クロウ$$! That line is mine...」

533:t_007:11.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Her song is the opposite of the power of life! Only your song can beat it!」

533:t_007:13.en:
$$アルト$$
「You! What are you saying at a time like this!」

533:t_007:14.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Her song is her song! No way I'm canceling out a song with a song!」

533:t_007:15.en:
$$バサラ$$
「If we're doing it, it's a session!」

533:t_007:17.en:
$$レイ#pt231$$
「In the end, it comes to this.」

533:t_007:18.en:
$$ミレーヌ$$
「All right! Let's sing our hearts out!」

533:t_009:0.en:
$$シビル$$
「Your... song... erases... $$スピリチア$$! But... $$バサラ$$'s... song... makes... $$スピリチア$$... more... and more!」

533:t_009:1.en:
$$尸刻$$
「Evil... one from another realm, outside the natural order... That one's song awakened even them to the power of life.」

533:t_009:2.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「$$尸刻$$ of the $$鬼宿$$. I take it your true role is to guide scattering lives in the right direction.」

533:t_009:4.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But what you are doing now goes against that providence and takes lives for nothing!」

533:t_009:9.en:
$$バサラ$$
「Come on, $$シビル$$! You sing too!!」

533:t_010:0.en:
$$オズマ$$
「Uoooooh!! The dynamite of a dream collab beyond species... now, explosion!!」

533:t_010:1.en:
$$キャシー$$
「You're getting carried away, $$スカル$$ 1!」

533:t_010:5.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$尸刻$$! You are living beings too!」

533:t_010:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Don't tell me you won't admit it!」

533:t_010:7.en:
$$尸刻$$
「But we have nowhere to return to. This is all we can do.」

533:t_011:0.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A resolve never to go back, huh...」

533:t_011:1.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Then we'll shatter that resolve and move forward!」

533:t_011:2.en:
$$カレン$$
「W-wow, $$ゼロ$$ today... He's so upbeat...!」
